text: Who goes there?!
zh: 谁在那儿？！

text: Oh, it's you, little one!
zh: 哦，是你啊，小家伙！

text: You need something?
zh: 有什么事吗？

text: I'm just an adventurer.
zh: 我只是个冒险者。

text: The last adventurer ended up stranded here, hah!
zh: 上一个冒险者最后被困死在了这儿，哈！

text: What are you going to do now?
zh: 你现在打算怎么办？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Do you know about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 你知道冠军硬币吗？

text: Tell me about your camp.
zh: 跟我说说你的营地。

text: Do you have something to do for me?
zh: 你有活儿给我干吗？

text: Why don't you let Randolph go free?
zh: 你为什么不放兰道夫走？

text: I found the King's Ruby.
zh: 我找到了国王的红宝石。

text: Regarding Randolph...
zh: 关于兰道夫……

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: Are you for real?
zh: 你是认真的吗？

text: I am #:Goran:#, the chief of these lousy bastards up here!
zh: 我是#:戈兰:#，山上这帮废物杂种的头儿！

text: Remember my name if you value your life.
zh: 要是还想活命，就记住我的名字。

text:
The what coin?
I am afraid I have no clue what you're talking about.
zh:
什么硬币？
恐怕我完全不知道你在说什么。

text: You'd have better luck going to that old wizard working for Balder.
zh: 你还不如去找那个给巴尔德干活的老巫师，兴许更有戏。

text: Anything else?
zh: 还有别的事吗？

text: Stop wasting my time!
zh: 别浪费我的时间！

text: Me and Balder used to work together before he got too soft for my liking.
zh: 我和巴尔德以前是一伙的，后来他软得让我看不下去了。

text: So I beat the crap out of him!
zh: 所以我把他狠揍了一顿！

text: He left the camp, taking a few of my men with him.
zh: 他离开了营地，还带走了我几个手下。

text: But I heard someone helped that Icefall dumbass already.
zh: 不过我听说，已经有人帮过那个冰瀑村的蠢货了。

text: Thinking about the adventurer... The  bridge broke down a while ago.
zh: 说起那个冒险者……桥前段时间就塌了。

text:
How did you end up here on this side of the river?
I don't think you belong to Balder's men, do you?
zh:
你是怎么到河这边来的？
你不像是巴尔德的人，对吧？

text: I don't know how I came here.
zh: 我不知道自己是怎么来的。

text: I was sent here by a god.
zh: 我是被一位神送来的。

text: I belong to Balder's men.
zh: 我是巴尔德的人。

text: I know when someone is lying to me.
zh: 谁在对我撒谎，我一眼就能看出来。

text: Anyway, is there something you need?
zh: 不管怎样，你有什么需要吗？

text:
By a god?
This sounds...
zh:
被神送来的？
这听起来……

text: ...unusual.
zh: ……真不寻常。

text:
Ha!
A worm like you?!
zh:
哈！
就你这条蛆虫？！

text: I know when someone is lying to me.
zh: 谁在对我撒谎，我一眼就能看出来。

text:
Randolph decided to run away with Balder back then.
So he decided AGAINST ME!
zh:
当年兰道夫决定跟着巴尔德跑了。
也就是说，他决定跟我作对！

text: So, why should I be so kind to let him go?!
zh: 那我凭什么好心放他走？！

text: What do you want?
zh: 你想要什么？

text: You can't give me what I truly want.
zh: 我真正想要的东西，你给不了。

text:
However, there is one little thing that interests me.
The #:King's Ruby:#.
zh:
不过，倒有一样小东西让我感兴趣。
#:国王的红宝石:#。

text: Supposedly, the ruby is buried somewhere in the royal crypt.
zh: 据说，那颗红宝石就埋在王室墓穴的某处。

text: Bring me the King's Ruby, and I will think about letting Randolph go free.
zh: 把国王的红宝石给我带来，我就考虑放兰道夫走。

text: Where is the crypt?
zh: 墓穴在哪儿？

text: Fine.
zh: 好吧。

text: Is there anything else?
zh: 还有别的事吗？

text: The crypt is located in the capital. You'll certainly find it once you visit the graveyard.
zh: 墓穴就在王都。你去墓园转转，肯定能找到。

text: Accessing the crypt is your problem, though.
zh: 不过，怎么进墓穴是你自己的事。

text: Yeah?
zh: 怎么？

text: Where can I find the gem?
zh: 我在哪儿能找到那颗宝石？

text: I gave you the ruby already.
zh: 红宝石我已经给你了。

text: How about I find new men for your camp?
zh: 我给你的营地找些新人手怎么样？

text: I found a new one for your camp.
zh: 我给你的营地找来了一个新人。

text: I found new men for your camp.
zh: 我给你的营地找来了新人手。

text: I'll be back.
zh: 我会回来的。

text: Supposedly, the ruby is buried somewhere in the royal crypt.
zh: 据说，那颗红宝石就埋在王室墓穴的某处。

text:
Hmph!
You want to bring me new men for the camp in exchange for Randolph?
zh:
哼！
你想用给营地找新人手来换兰道夫？

text: Got afraid after hearing about a crypt, did ya?
zh: 一听到墓穴就怕了，是吧？

text:
Yeah whatever!
Bring me at least #:one more:# guy for the camp. Then, we shall talk about Randolph again!
zh:
行吧，随便！
至少给营地#:再带一个:#人来。到时候，我们再谈兰道夫的事！

text:
Well then...
We had a deal.
zh:
那好……
我们可是说定了的。

text: As far as I'm concerned, Randolph and his friend can crawl back to Balder's ass.
zh: 要我说，兰道夫和他那朋友尽管爬回巴尔德的屁股底下去好了。

text:
HELL YEAH!
You fucking did it!
zh:
太他妈好了！
你真的办成了！

text: Now let me see that!
zh: 快让我瞧瞧！

text:
It is incredible.
You can't imagine how long I've been waiting for this moment.
zh:
太不可思议了。
你无法想象我等这一刻等了多久。

text:
Come back later!
There's something I need to do.
zh:
晚点再来！
我有件事要办。

text:
Well then. There is something I am interested in.
The #:King's Ruby:#.
zh:
那好。有样东西我很感兴趣。
#:国王的红宝石:#。

text:
I already told you.
Bring me the King's Ruby!
zh:
我已经跟你说过了。
把国王的红宝石带来！

text: Then we may talk again about Randolph.
zh: 到时候我们再谈兰道夫的事。

text: If you want to do something, start with that.
zh: 你要是想干点什么，就先从这件事干起。

text: Supposedly, the ruby is buried somewhere in the royal crypt.
zh: 据说，那颗红宝石就埋在王室墓穴的某处。

text:
Come back later!
I have something important to do.
zh:
晚点再来！
我有要紧事要办。

text: For this traitor?
zh: 为了这个叛徒？

text:
You? Really?
A nobody like you asking for work?
zh:
你？当真？
你这样的无名小卒也来讨活儿干？

text: I am not a nobody!
zh: 我可不是什么无名小卒！

text: Forget it.
zh: 算了。

text: I already thought so.
zh: 我早就猜到了。

text:
You know what?
Randolph should go back to Balder.
zh:
你猜怎么着？
兰道夫还是回巴尔德那儿去吧。

text: I have other things to take care of anyway.
zh: 反正我还有别的事要操心。

text: Take care of yourself, little one!
zh: 自己保重，小家伙！

text:
Honestly, I don't know.
I was hoping to get rid of my #:problem:# with the King's Ruby.
zh:
说实话，我不知道。
我本指望用国王的红宝石解决我的#:麻烦:#。

text: Now that that's off the table, I need to figure out something else.
zh: 既然这条路走不通了，我就得另想办法。

text: Maybe, I should leave the camp for a while.
zh: 也许，我该离开营地一段时间。
